company.shortDescription: Tennr is a healthcare AI startup that provides an automation platform for medical documents.
company.description: Tennr is a healthcare AI startup that optimizes healthcare operations by automating back-office tasks. The company leverages AI technology to replace traditional faxing systems and streamline communication processes in healthcare, ensuring patients receive timely care.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that automates the processing of medical documents, including classification, data extraction, eligibility checks, and benefits investigations to streamline patient intake and referral management.
productsAndServices.name: Tennr Automation Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool within the platform that manages and coordinates complex healthcare operational workflows such as eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and communication with providers and patients.
productsAndServices.name: Tennr Workflow Manager

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary AI model trained to interpret unstructured medical records and match them against complex payor criteria for accurate document processing and authorization.
